# Copilot Instructions

See [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root for full guidance on commands, code style, architecture, and conventions.

## Additional notes

- The `samples/` and `fixtures/` folders are used for testing. Do **not** flag or fix spelling errors in those folders — they are either intentional (testing the parser's handling of misspellings) or will be caught by the project's own linter/spellchecker. Both directories are excluded from Prettier, ESLint, and `tsc` for this reason.
